name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Blockade; IRGC claims tankers hit mines 23 Nov
summary: IRGC says two tankers hit mines east of Hormuz; Iran vows every means against US blockade; attacks at a wartime high
state: Iran's foreign ministry said on 23 Nov it would use every means to counter the US blockade of its ports, after Trump said on 22 Nov ships trying to break it would be sunk (Euronews). The IRGC navy said two tankers exploded after hitting mines north of Ghanem Island east of Hormuz, and claimed it shot down a US MQ-1 drone on 22 Nov; UKMTO is investigating a tanker incident in the Gulf of Oman (ABC News via Yahoo). The US widened the blockade on 19 Nov to ship-to-ship cargoes; 16 ship attacks were logged in November by 19 Nov (USNI News).
for_you: Shipping and energy markets face disruption through Hormuz. Follow FCDO travel advice for Gulf states and UKMTO advisories for mariners.
rubric_hit: Active state-on-state strikes and attacks on Gulf shipping = Alert

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
